tankmate.notes: Away Alerts are here: if an alarm sounds while you're away, TankMate keeps the alert safe and passes it along — through the hub first, then any Buddy app with a connection — until it can reach your phone. Tap the Away Alerts button to see yours. Your tanks and settings carry over.

buddyboardlite.notes: Buddy Board Lite is now the family's update ferry: while it has internet it can fetch the newest Buddy apps, then share them with the main board nearby — you confirm first, with a plain warning that the main board's alarms and heaters pause while it updates. Away Alerts arrive too. Nothing else changes.
